items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: I lived next door, half a house with Billy Moriah, Simon Moriah, Joe and John Moriah. We were all like a family.

ctx.x: Where did Sidney be? Sidney lived close around there sometimes.

I lived next door, half a house with Billy Moriah, Simon Moriah, Joe and John Moriah. We were all like a family. Double house. I could hear them over there rehearsing and everything. That's where... Buddy Petit's band was rehearsing in that same house, right next to our house. Simon was playing bass with Buddy. And the father was playing bass with the superior band of them. One of them. Old man Bill Moriah. One of them like I conceived a day. Could Buddy Petit play? Huh? Could Buddy Petit play good? Yeah. He…
